rules.tests: exact canonical defaults, native clamping through the C setters, every mode identity, non-finite and unknown-identity rejection, cross-type handle refusal, cell-size validation, a real ASCII draw with observed grid dimensions and destroy/lifetime paths on SDL_RENDERER with the extension layer; the complete unavailable contract on HEADLESS without it; strict-C `GraphicsExtSmoke.c` plus C/C++ handle assertions

rules.mapping: owned `CNA_StorageContainerHandle` resources opened from a storage device: display-name and fully-qualified type-name count/copy, disposal state, the owning device's handle, explicit `cna_storage_container_dispose` and owned `Disposing` callback registration; directory create/exists/delete and file create/exists/delete; both `GetDirectoryNames` and both `GetFileNames` overloads expressed as a count plus an indexed copy, where an empty search pattern selects the no-argument overload; `CreateFile` and all three `OpenFile` overloads returning an owned `CNA_StorageStreamHandle` (`cna_storage_container_open_file`, `_open_file_access`, `_open_file_share`). `System::IO::Stream` never becomes a C type: the stream handle exposes read/write/seek/position/length/set-length/flush/capability/close only, and a stream is a child of its container just as a container is a child of its device
rules.tests: `StorageSmoke.c` display/type-name count-copy round trips and buffer-too-small refusal, disposal state, owning-device identity, one-shot `Disposing` delivery across repeated disposal, directory create/exists/list/delete including glob and empty-pattern listings and out-of-range name indexes, file create/exists/list/delete, byte-exact write/read round trip, seek from begin and end plus the negative-position I/O refusal, read-only write refusal, `SetLength` truncation, rejected file mode/access/share identities, the append-with-read refusal, the missing-file I/O result, and stream-before-container destruction ordering, under HEADLESS, SDL_RENDERER and SOFTWARE

rules.mapping: owned `CNA_StorageDeviceHandle` resources: free space, total space and connection state; process-wide `DeviceChanged` callback registration, matching the canonical event's static storage; `DeleteContainer`; the four `BeginShowSelector`/`EndShowSelector` fake-async pairs collapsed into `cna_storage_device_show_selector`, `_for_player`, `_with_space` and `_for_player_with_space`, and the `BeginOpenContainer`/`EndOpenContainer` pair into `cna_storage_container_open`. CNA completes all of them before `Begin` returns, so each C route stays one synchronous call that still invokes the canonical completion callback and no `System::IAsyncResult` or operation handle is invented for work that never pends. `SetAppNameEXT` and `GetStorageRootEXT` become `cna_storage_set_app_name_ext` and root size/copy
rules.tests: `StorageSmoke.c` all four selector overloads with and without a completion callback, negative space and unknown player refusals, free/total/connection queries, `DeviceChanged` subscribe/unsubscribe and stale-registration refusal, container open with completion callback, container deletion including the escaping and empty title-name refusals, and container-before-device destruction ordering, under HEADLESS, SDL_RENDERER and SOFTWARE

rules.mapping: the C exception firewall converts this canonical failure before it can cross the ABI: a disconnected storage device becomes `CNA_RESULT_INVALID_STATE` with `CNA_ERROR_CATEGORY_STATE`, and both the default and a custom message reach the caller through the per-thread UTF-8 diagnostic. No exception object, type name or C++ throw is exposed
rules.tests: default-message and custom-message conversion, including exact result, category and diagnostic text, in the `cna_c_api_boundary_detail_test` adapter test
